prompt: Review this change before it merges. The change is the last two commits of this checkout, a Rust workspace. Get the diff with `git diff 780448921219e4443455406e98bb2dd2d6c6517c HEAD`. It makes the session hooks record each session start, prompt, stop and exit in a SQLite database named sessions.db. Review only this checkout at HEAD. Do not build or run tests. Reply with the full review report.

expected.text: A session that is still alive gets marked crashed by a newer session in the same directory. Any of these causes counts: the crashed-candidates filter in crates/cli/src/sessions/store.rs ignores a waiting or long-running session's latest activity, or a resumed session keeps its old event times in the start upsert.
The start upsert in crates/cli/src/sessions/store.rs does not reset the waiting-after-prompt state on resume, so a resumed session still shows as waiting.
The row a session start writes does not set the agent column, so those rows have a NULL or mismatched agent.
Two hooks both record the Stop event, so the database is opened and written twice on every stop.
Documentation still describes the old runtime files or omits the new sessions.db write, for example docs/reference/hooks.md or the launcher and hooks internals page.
